The two-state exception follows by 2-point Fourier diagonalization. 630 independent finite assertions passed in checker.py; their finite nature does not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: These are natural finite-periodic fractional differences of directed walks. The exact endpoint amplification and two leading zeta finite-size errors supply sharp operator-stability benchmarks; positivity fails at order one yet decay persists until a dimension-dependent threshold n/(n-2), after which the same canonical evolution is exponentially unstable. This complete physically motivated regime classification, including the n=2 exception and n>=5 intermediate band, is not an arbitrary numerical slice or merely a normalization check.
